symptom: `DESCRIBE microflow` on the **modelsdk** engine renders a legacy SOAP `call web service …` as `-- Empty action`
insight: Add the case: read the structured fields (ImportedService / OperationName / NewResultHandling / RequestHandling) and, when the action carries any field the structured form can't represent, set `RawBSON = a.Raw()` so the renderer emits `call web service raw '<base64>'`. Mirror legacy's supported-key set exactly; `canonicalRawBSON` makes both engines' base64 byte-identical
